description_en: Queries the list of nodes in a specified node group based on filter conditions by calling ListNodesByNodeGroupId
description_zh: 调用ListNodesByNodeGroupId根据过滤条件，查询指定节点分组中的节点列表
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-nodes-by-node-group-id --iot-instance-id example-string --node-group-id 123 --fuzzy-dev-eui d896e0 --offset 0 --limit 2 --sorting-field CREATED_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2019-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodesByNodeGroupId

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node group
parameters.name: node_group_id

parameters.help_en: The DevEUI of the node for fuzzy matching
parameters.name: fuzzy_dev_eui

parameters.help_en: The start position of this query, starting from 0
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的起始位置，从0开始
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of nodes to return in this query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 本次查询的节点数量上限，大于等于1
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Valid value: **CREATED_MILLIS**, which indicates sorting by creation time
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序字段，可取值为**CREATED_MILLIS**，表示根据创建时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Used together with the **SortingField** parameter. A value of **true** indicates ascending order, and a value of **false** indicates descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合**SortingField**参数一起使用，**true**表示升序，**false**表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

v1_parameters.help_en: Used together with the **SortingField** parameter. A value of **true** indicates ascending order, and a value of **false** indicates descending order
v1_parameters.help_zh: 配合**SortingField**参数一起使用，**true**表示升序，**false**表示降序

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the node group
